items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Billy Brooks, saxophone, we had Jay Peters, Bobby Plater.

ctx.x: The only other person from New Orleans is Chuck Beatty.

Yeah, Chuck Beatty. And let me see, we had Walter Williams on trumpet. Okay. Moon Mullins, Eddie Mudd on trumpet. Billy Brooks, saxophone, we had Jay Peters, Bobby Plater. I forgot who played baritone. Looks like Oscar Estelle.
